ideas.name: ECB Fix Dollar Reversal
ideas.claim: The US dollar tends to appreciate before the ECB reference-rate fixing and depreciate afterward.
ideas.quote: This paper studies demand shocks for U.S. dollars in high frequency around currency fixings and documents a new empirical fact: the U.S. dollar systematically appreciates ahead of the three major currency fixings and depreciates thereafter.
ideas.mechanism: Dealer hedging and spot-market order imbalances around currency fixings.

rules.market: G9 currencies against the US dollar

ideas.claimed_result: The paper reports an average US dollar peak at the ECB fix, with appreciation beforehand and depreciation afterward; its full sample covers January 1999 through December 2019.
